goal.objective: Produce the pure adaptive run controller, portable RunView, and independent test contract required to turn approved runtime assignments into a visible IDE-agnostic orchestration loop.

assumptions.statement: Adaptive APIs remain additive to the released V11 and V12 public behavior.
assumptions.rationale: V14 must preserve existing compilation and immutable session contracts.

assumptions.statement: This package produces disjoint implementation and test artifacts; executable integration verification and independent review use a successor package over the assembled commit.
assumptions.rationale: A parallel test author cannot truthfully certify implementation bytes that do not exist at launch.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pure controller validates assignments, emits dependency-safe host commands, records exact host events, settles V12 handoffs, restores state, and routes bounded outcomes.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce the closed adaptive controller, event protocol, schema, and session operations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: An independently authored suite defines lifecycle, restart, event-chain, redaction, RunView, and public-schema expectations before integration.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce the independent executable adaptive and RunView test contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pure RunView projection exposes modules, assignments, status, dependencies, evidence, routes, blockers, source links, and next action without inventing host facts.

evidenceRequirements.description: Produce closed JSON and Markdown RunView projections.
